statements.text: I have reviewed the exact complaint text, recipient, and attachments and believe the statements I am submitting are accurate to the best of my knowledge.
I understand that observed call metadata, caller statements, and AI inferences are different types of evidence; that the identity of the responsible caller or business may be unverified.
I understand that filing a complaint does not establish a legal violation or guarantee investigation, compensation, or removal from a calling list.
I authorize transmission of the selected information to the named recipient using the described submission channel.
I understand I am responsible for confirming that I am entitled to disclose the included material, and that recordings or transcripts may be subject to consent laws.
